verdict.score_rationale: The board lands at 6.5 because its strong operational vocabulary and deliberate regional composition are held back by a substantial dead lower band and several sprawling feedback routes with visibly unresolved endpoints.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: The main regions occupy most of the upper canvas, but a large unexplained band of empty frame remains beneath them and the lower-left panel is notably sparse.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Color is restrained and semantically consistent: teal marks assistant/orchestration, pink marks model/judge functions, blue marks memory and knowledge, red marks safety or regression, green marks delivery or approval, and yellow marks people, messages, keys, and notes.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: No crosshair junctions are visible, but long red, blue, green, and dashed feedback wires dominate the lower half, with some routes ending or turning in open space near the product-owner and quality areas.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: The primary conversation flow holds a clear horizontal register and the section containers establish hierarchy, though tiny labels, widely varying gaps, and sprawling return paths weaken rhythm in the rollout section.
